TextView.android:text: Welcome to GymForge — your personal training companion!

GymForge helps you build and track your fitness journey with four core sections:

🏠 Home — Your daily dashboard with quick-start workouts and today's stats.

🏋️ Workouts — Browse all available workout plans and tap any to see the full routine.

📈 Progress — Log completed sessions, track your weight, and measure how close you are to your goal.

⚙️ Settings — Personalise the app by setting your name, fitness level, weekly workout goal, and preferred weight unit. All preferences are saved automatically.

How to use:
1. Tap a workout card to view the full routine.
2. After completing a session, head to Progress and tap 'Log Workout'.
3. Set your preferences in Settings to tailor the experience.
